# impl

## Overview
Generated GrammarKit PSI element implementations for Dart AST nodes.

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.psi.impl.Dart*Impl (e.g., DartClassDefinitionImpl, DartMethodDeclarationImpl, DartExpressionImpl, DartForStatementImpl)

## Invariants
- Most nodes extend the hand-written `DartPsiCompositeElementImpl`; expressions extend the generated `DartExpressionImpl` or the hand-written `DartOperatorExpressionImpl` / `DartReferenceImpl`; declarations (about 18 classes, e.g. `DartClassDefinitionImpl`, `DartEnumDefinitionImpl`) extend the hand-written `AbstractDartPsiClass` or `AbstractDartComponentImpl`. Hand-written bases live in `src/main/java/com/jetbrains/lang/dart/psi/impl/`. None extend `ASTWrapperPsiElement` directly.
- Auto-generated by GrammarKit; not intended for manual editing.

## Side Effects
- Performs PSI tree navigation and AST node lookup within IntelliJ PSI read actions.
